event: After the meal, Solenne still half-waits on the six signals in the Conductor.
She knows the Gate has been completed.
They gather their packs; Nadia puts on the dulcimer case.
The entry door opens for them and Solenne steps through first.
A sixth door now stands in the antechamber's far wall.
Solenne stops; the party stops behind her.
The System announces that one trial remains.
Tomás says that wasn't in the first notification; Solenne agrees.
Solenne reads the six signals, each changed by the trials.
Nadia looks at the door, then at each of them, Solenne last.
Nadia sets the dulcimer case at Solenne's feet: "Hold this."
Nadia walks through the sixth door.
Nadia stands in an empty white room whose air feels attentive.
She waits in the center for the evaluation to begin; nothing happens.
She recalls being evaluated since age seven and her skill at performed presence.
She fills the room with practiced presence; the air does not change.
She sits against the wall in a contained, inward presence; no change.
She stands in the center in open receptivity; no change.
She reviews what the trial asked of each of the other four.
She infers the Trial tests each Aspect in its hardest mode.
She catches herself analyzing in order to perform, and stops.
She sits in the center of the room and looks at the wall, about eight minutes in.
She considers using Pattern Break on the Trial's pattern.
She sees that would be a performance of non-performance; she is in a loop.
She stays in the loop, honestly not knowing what to do, and breathes.
She thinks about Dayo holding the tally bracer and asking if Nadia was still in.
She thinks about Miriam asking for the Mana Vial.
She thinks about Vesper's turned-over hands and "I didn't need it."
She thinks about Tomás's exhale and his unexplained mistake.
She thinks about Solenne on the floor, receiving them all and holding the case.
The room's attention changes texture.
She notices the change and lets the awareness be, without chasing it.
A hum builds in her chest and resolves into a short phrase.
She hums it, not for the room, and stops when it stops.
She sits in a very large silence and does not fill it.
Her trial completes: Genuinely Present, minimum threshold met, at 23:17.
Nadia rises to Level 12; Chaos Grenade rises to level 7.
The notice also declares Floor 20 cleared, with party XP and a section bonus.
Nadia reads it twice and finds the minimum threshold funny.
She stands on stiff legs, picks up her pack and walks to the door.
In the antechamber, Dayo, Miriam and Vesper wait; Tomás holds Floor 21 advance notes.
Solenne stands with the dulcimer case at her feet.
Nadia walks out.
Nadia says it took her a minute; Solenne says twenty-three minutes seventeen.
Nadia says, "Yeah."
Solenne feels a held weight set down and finds it quietly funny.
The System opens the Proving Gate and grants +1 RES to the whole party.
All the trial doors open together onto a lit Transition Hall with a fire-bowl.
Nadia picks up the dulcimer case and settles it on her back.
Nadia feels the Tower's Mana pulse differently and files it.
Tomás asks if they're ready; Dayo and Vesper say yeah.
Miriam, notebook closed, looks forward; Solenne says yes; Nadia says yeah.
They walk into the Transition Hall; the fire-bowl is lit and Floor 21's door waits.
They sit down.
